messages:
alex: Heads-up — published 3.2.1 is breaking edge runtimes when importing the JS SDK. Repro in a Next.js edge function: `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'` -> immediate module resolution error.

alex: Quick error shown in Vercel logs:
```
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Package subpath './dist/index.mjs' not found
    at new NodeError (node:internal/errors:329:5)
    at finalizeResolution (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:429:11)
    at moduleResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:1001:10)
```

bella: yikes. I noticed the publish job had a warning about exports map last night but assumed it was transient. looks like the tarball doesn't contain `.mjs` at all.

chris: Confirmed on Cloudflare Workers too — edge runtimes are strict about ESM entrypoints. Also sourcemaps are missing so stack traces are just minified/transpiled locations.

alex: Checked the npm tarball: `dist/` only has `index.cjs` and `index.d.ts`. No `index.mjs` and no `index.cjs.map` / `index.mjs.map`.

bella: Root cause hypothesis: our bundler (tsup/rollup) emitted only CJS because `--platform=node` was set in CI for prod publish. The package.json `exports` points at `./dist/index.mjs` for `import` — mismatch.

chris: That matches. Exports map currently in package.json:
```
"exports": {
  "./index.js": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }
}
```
If `index.mjs` missing, Node/edge throws.

alex: Immediate remediation options:
- unpublish 3.2.1 and republish a fixed 3.2.2 with proper artifacts
- or republish 3.2.1 as a patched tarball (but npm unpublish policies may block)

bella: I'll prepare a 3.2.2 publish with the correct build config. Also adding a post-publish verification step to CI to assert the tarball contains `dist/*.mjs`, `dist/*.cjs`, `*.map`, and `index.d.ts`.

chris: We should also update samples/edge-example to import the CJS fallback in the short term: `const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs')` — not ideal but unblocks internal testing.

dana (ci-bot): Logged publish job artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7845 — publish used `format: 'cjs'` in prod bundle step. Created INF-4321 for postpublish checks.

alex: Can someone open a rollback/publish request in #release-war-room? This is blocking a customer PoC.

bella: PR opened to fix tsup config + package.json exports: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/999 — will run full publish flow after approvals.

chris: Also adding a unit test in publish pipeline that extracts `npm pack` tarball and verifies files + a small node script that tries `import()` the package in an ES vm to catch runtime ESM errors.

alex: One more follow-up: source maps missing made debugging painful. Add mapping output for both mjs and cjs builds and include in tarball as `.map` files.

bella: noted. I'll include `--sourcemap` in both builds and ensure `package.json` `files` includes `dist/*.map`.

dana (ci-bot): INF-4321 assigned to @bella, priority: high. Automated rollback suggestion posted in release-war-room.

chris: I'll push a branch with the temporary sample change and a docs note for customers using edge runtimes until 3.2.2 is out.

alex: Thanks all. Marking this thread blocker. Ping me once 3.2.2 publish completes and we've validated on Vercel + Cloudflare.

bella: will do. :thumbsup:

chris: on it. :ok_hand:
